agent.problem: The setup says only that Paul adds how salvation happens; no earlier card introduces or points toward faith. The baker must supply the unseen wording of “through ___” rather than reason out a meaning established by the walkthrough.

rule.text: The rule against guessing the next words of a line (see below) applies to every passage, and to fill in the blank too. The blank tests meaning the baker can reason out, not wording they haven't seen.

agent.problem: “Do good words” and especially “do good dreams” are not believable completions. The nonsensical distractors make “works” stand out as the only natural-sounding answer.

rule.text: Don't let the right answer stand out. All the answers should sound alike.
